name: blueprint/reminder-flow
description: The agent as its own scheduler: rh_events_* reminders checked each turn, rh_notify_send to interrupt yourself on your devices, one store receipt per delivery. Escalation is Cloudflare cron (documented, not built).
use_cases: remind me to send X at 9am
ingredients: rh_notify_send (ntfy.sh, keyless - unguessable topic is the only secret)
recipe: create the event -> each turn rh_events_due returns the pending events whose time has come and marks them notified (delivered exactly once, never silently dropped) -> rh_notify_send to the topic -> store a receipt { eventId, at, notifiedAt }
result_kind: per-turn agent routine + one store receipt per delivery

invoke_contract.due: { horizonHours? } -> { id, title, detail, at }[] (and marks them notified)
invoke_contract.free: { durationMinutes, horizonHours? } -> ISO slot strings within working hours

config_variants.cadence: every turn (agent loop) | cron escalation (user's Cloudflare)

pitfalls: run rh_events_due EVERY turn - a missed run still leaves the event pending, but the delivery waits
due marks notified at return time: exactly-once comes from the state flip, not from the caller
the ntfy topic name is the only secret - unguessable random string, never a guessable name
freeSlots is local-time working hours 09:00-17:00 - mind the machine timezone
one-off events only; recurring reminders are create-again-on-fire or the cron escalation
local_limits: delivery only happens on turns the agent actually runs; no wake-from-sleep
cloud_limits: cron escalation (documented) needs a Worker + the user's Cloudflare account; not a built primitive yet
